why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 1.18 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 16.5 points of that tide, a tailwind for Kevin Mullin.

D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Kevin Mullin leads by 62.9 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 169,715 votes; a one point swing is about 1,349 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +58.5 and D +66.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.2 points toward Kevin Mullin. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
